tv_wonder_sacred_mountain_ritual_annex = {
	is_special = yes
	is_foreign = no
	pop_type = clergy
	max_levels = 6
	employment_size = 0.1
	category = cultural_category

	town = yes
	city = yes
	megalopolis = yes
	rural_settlement = yes

	important_for_AI = no
	automation_build_allowed = no
	country_potential = { always = no }
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_WONDER_ENGINEERING_ONLY_BUILDING_TT
			always = no
		}
	}
	can_destroy = { always = no }

	price = tv_wonder_ritual_annex_small_price

	build_time = religious_building_time
	construction_demand = town_building_construction

	modifier = {
		local_pop_conversion_speed = 0.01
		local_clergy_estate_power = 0.5
	}

	possible_production_methods = {
		tv_wonder_module_maintenance
	}

	on_built = {
		hidden_effect = {
			location.owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = tv_wonder_ritual_in_progress
						var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 1
						var:tv_wonder_ceremony_style ?= 2
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ritual_auxiliary_building_finished value = 1 }
					tv_wonder_complete_active_ritual_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_construction_ended = {
		hidden_effect = {
			owner = {
				tv_wonder_mechanics_mark_completed_auxiliary_building_ritual_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

tv_wonder_giant_necropolis_ritual_annex = {
	is_special = yes
	is_foreign = no
	pop_type = nobles
	max_levels = 6
	employment_size = 0.1
	category = cultural_category

	town = yes
	city = yes
	megalopolis = yes
	rural_settlement = yes

	important_for_AI = no
	automation_build_allowed = no
	country_potential = { always = no }
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_WONDER_ENGINEERING_ONLY_BUILDING_TT
			always = no
		}
	}
	can_destroy = { always = no }

	price = tv_wonder_ritual_annex_medium_price

	build_time = large_cultural_building_time
	construction_demand = library_construction

	modifier = {
		local_unrest = -0.05
		local_cultural_tradition = 0.5
		local_nobles_estate_power = 0.5
	}

	possible_production_methods = {
		tv_wonder_module_maintenance
	}

	on_built = {
		hidden_effect = {
			location.owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = tv_wonder_ritual_in_progress
						var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 4
						var:tv_wonder_ceremony_style ?= 2
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ritual_auxiliary_building_finished value = 1 }
					tv_wonder_complete_active_ritual_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_construction_ended = {
		hidden_effect = {
			owner = {
				tv_wonder_mechanics_mark_completed_auxiliary_building_ritual_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

tv_wonder_hydraulic_workshop_ritual_annex = {
	is_special = yes
	is_foreign = no
	pop_type = laborers
	max_levels = 6
	employment_size = 0.1
	category = infrastructure_category

	town = yes
	city = yes
	megalopolis = yes
	rural_settlement = yes

	important_for_AI = no
	automation_build_allowed = no
	country_potential = { always = no }
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_WONDER_ENGINEERING_ONLY_BUILDING_TT
			always = no
		}
	}
	can_destroy = { always = no }

	price = tv_wonder_ritual_annex_medium_price

	build_time = infrastructure_build_time
	construction_demand = basic_construction_needs

	modifier = {
		local_production_efficiency = 0.2
		local_peasants_estate_power = 0.5
	}

	possible_production_methods = {
		tv_wonder_module_maintenance
	}

	on_built = {
		hidden_effect = {
			location.owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = tv_wonder_ritual_in_progress
						var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 6
						var:tv_wonder_ceremony_style ?= 2
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ritual_auxiliary_building_finished value = 1 }
					tv_wonder_complete_active_ritual_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_construction_ended = {
		hidden_effect = {
			owner = {
				tv_wonder_mechanics_mark_completed_auxiliary_building_ritual_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

	is_special = yes
	is_foreign = no
	pop_type = clergy
	max_levels = 6
	employment_size = 0.1
	category = cultural_category

	town = yes
	city = yes
	megalopolis = yes
	rural_settlement = yes

	important_for_AI = no
	automation_build_allowed = no
	country_potential = { always = no }
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_WONDER_ENGINEERING_ONLY_BUILDING_TT
			always = no
		}
	}
	can_destroy = { always = no }

	price = tv_wonder_ritual_annex_medium_price

	build_time = religious_building_time
	construction_demand = town_building_construction

	modifier = {
		local_migration_attraction = 1
		local_pop_conversion_speed = 10
		local_clergy_estate_power = 0.5
	}

	possible_production_methods = {
		tv_wonder_module_maintenance
	}

	on_built = {
		hidden_effect = {
			location.owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = tv_wonder_ritual_in_progress
						var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 11
						var:tv_wonder_ceremony_style ?= 2
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ritual_auxiliary_building_finished value = 1 }
					tv_wonder_complete_active_ritual_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_construction_ended = {
		hidden_effect = {
			owner = {
				tv_wonder_mechanics_mark_completed_auxiliary_building_ritual_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

			text = TV_WONDER_ENGINEERING_ONLY_BUILDING_TT
			always = no
		}
	}
	can_destroy = { always = no }

	price = tv_wonder_ritual_annex_medium_price

	build_time = small_fort_building
	construction_demand = fort_construction

	modifier = {
		local_unrest = -0.1
		local_crown_estate_power = 0.5
	}

	possible_production_methods = {
		tv_wonder_module_maintenance
	}

	on_built = {
		hidden_effect = {
			location.owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = tv_wonder_ritual_in_progress
						var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 15
						var:tv_wonder_ceremony_style ?= 2
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ritual_auxiliary_building_finished value = 1 }
					tv_wonder_complete_active_ritual_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_construction_ended = {
		hidden_effect = {
			owner = {
				tv_wonder_mechanics_mark_completed_auxiliary_building_ritual_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

		}

			}
		}
	}

tv_wonder_frontier_colonization_belt_ritual_annex = {
	is_special = yes
	is_foreign = no
	pop_type = laborers
	max_levels = 6
	employment_size = 0.1
	category = infrastructure_category

	town = yes
	city = yes
	megalopolis = yes
	rural_settlement = yes

	important_for_AI = no
	automation_build_allowed = no
	country_potential = { always = no }
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_WONDER_ENGINEERING_ONLY_BUILDING_TT
			always = no
		}
	}
	can_destroy = { always = no }

	price = tv_wonder_ritual_annex_small_price

	build_time = infrastructure_build_time
	construction_demand = basic_construction_needs

	modifier = {
		local_market_access = 0.2
		local_peasants_estate_power = 0.5
	}

	possible_production_methods = {
		tv_wonder_module_maintenance
	}

	on_built = {
		hidden_effect = {
			location.owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = tv_wonder_ritual_in_progress
						var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 25
						var:tv_wonder_ceremony_style ?= 2
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ritual_auxiliary_building_finished value = 1 }
					tv_wonder_complete_active_ritual_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_construction_ended = {
		hidden_effect = {
			owner = {
				tv_wonder_mechanics_mark_completed_auxiliary_building_ritual_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

tv_wonder_royal_art_district_ritual_annex = {
	is_special = yes
	is_foreign = no
	pop_type = burghers
	max_levels = 6
	employment_size = 0.1
	category = cultural_category

	town = yes
	city = yes
	megalopolis = yes
	rural_settlement = yes

	important_for_AI = no
	automation_build_allowed = no
	country_potential = { always = no }
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_WONDER_ENGINEERING_ONLY_BUILDING_TT
			always = no
		}
	}
	can_destroy = { always = no }

	price = tv_wonder_ritual_annex_large_price

	build_time = large_cultural_building_time
	construction_demand = library_construction

	modifier = {
		local_migration_attraction = 2
		local_burghers_estate_power = 0.5
	}

	possible_production_methods = {
		tv_wonder_module_maintenance
	}

	on_built = {
		hidden_effect = {
			location.owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = tv_wonder_ritual_in_progress
						var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 30
						var:tv_wonder_ceremony_style ?= 2
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ritual_auxiliary_building_finished value = 1 }
					tv_wonder_complete_active_ritual_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_construction_ended = {
		hidden_effect = {
			owner = {
				tv_wonder_mechanics_mark_completed_auxiliary_building_ritual_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

	city = yes
	megalopolis = yes
	rural_settlement = yes

	automation_build_allowed = no
	country_potential = { always = no }
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_WONDER_ENGINEERING_ONLY_BUILDING_TT
			always = no
		}
	}
	can_destroy = { always = no }

	price = tv_wonder_ritual_annex_medium_price

	build_time = government_build_time
	construction_demand = capital_building_construction

	modifier = {
		local_raw_material_output = 0.25
		local_burghers_estate_power = 0.5
	}

	possible_production_methods = {
		tv_wonder_module_maintenance
	}

	on_built = {
		hidden_effect = {
			location.owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = tv_wonder_ritual_in_progress
						var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 35
						var:tv_wonder_ceremony_style ?= 2
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ritual_auxiliary_building_finished value = 1 }
					tv_wonder_complete_active_ritual_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_construction_ended = {
		hidden_effect = {
			owner = {
				tv_wonder_mechanics_mark_completed_auxiliary_building_ritual_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

tv_wonder_city_expansion_project_ritual_annex = {
	is_special = yes
	is_foreign = no
	pop_type = burghers
	max_levels = 6
	employment_size = 0.1
	category = infrastructure_category

	town = yes
	city = yes
	megalopolis = yes
	rural_settlement = yes

	important_for_AI = no
	automation_build_allowed = no
	country_potential = { always = no }
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_WONDER_ENGINEERING_ONLY_BUILDING_TT
			always = no
		}
	}
	can_destroy = { always = no }

	price = tv_wonder_ritual_annex_medium_price

	build_time = infrastructure_build_time
	construction_demand = basic_construction_needs

	modifier = {
		local_monthly_development_modifier = 0.1
		local_migration_attraction = 2
		local_burghers_estate_power = 0.5
	}

	possible_production_methods = {
		tv_wonder_module_maintenance
	}

	on_built = {
		hidden_effect = {
			location.owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = tv_wonder_ritual_in_progress
						var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 40
						var:tv_wonder_ceremony_style ?= 2
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ritual_auxiliary_building_finished value = 1 }
					tv_wonder_complete_active_ritual_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_construction_ended = {
		hidden_effect = {
			owner = {
				tv_wonder_mechanics_mark_completed_auxiliary_building_ritual_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

	city = yes
	megalopolis = yes
	rural_settlement = yes

	important_for_AI = no
	automation_build_allowed = no
	country_potential = { always = no }
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_WONDER_ENGINEERING_ONLY_BUILDING_TT
			always = no
		}
	}
	can_destroy = { always = no }

	price = tv_wonder_ritual_annex_large_price

	build_time = large_cultural_building_time
	construction_demand = library_construction

	modifier = {
		local_monthly_prosperity = 0.4
		local_burghers_estate_power = 0.5
	}

	possible_production_methods = {
		tv_wonder_module_maintenance
	}

	on_built = {
		hidden_effect = {
			location.owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = tv_wonder_ritual_in_progress
						var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 45
						var:tv_wonder_ceremony_style ?= 2
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ritual_auxiliary_building_finished value = 1 }
					tv_wonder_complete_active_ritual_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_construction_ended = {
		hidden_effect = {
			owner = {
				tv_wonder_mechanics_mark_completed_auxiliary_building_ritual_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

tv_wonder_mobile_fortress_ritual_annex = {
	is_special = yes
	is_foreign = no
	pop_type = soldiers
	max_levels = 6
	employment_size = 0.1
	category = military_category

	town = yes
	city = yes
	megalopolis = yes
	rural_settlement = yes

	important_for_AI = no
	automation_build_allowed = no
	country_potential = { always = no }
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_WONDER_ENGINEERING_ONLY_BUILDING_TT
			always = no
		}
	}
	can_destroy = { always = no }

	price = tv_wonder_ritual_annex_medium_price

	build_time = small_fort_building
	construction_demand = fort_construction

	modifier = {
		local_defensive = 0.15
		local_hostile_attrition = 0.05
		local_crown_estate_power = 0.5
	}

	possible_production_methods = {
		tv_wonder_module_maintenance
	}

	on_built = {
		hidden_effect = {
			location.owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = tv_wonder_ritual_in_progress
						var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 50
						var:tv_wonder_ceremony_style ?= 2
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ritual_auxiliary_building_finished value = 1 }
					tv_wonder_complete_active_ritual_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_construction_ended = {
		hidden_effect = {
			owner = {
				tv_wonder_mechanics_mark_completed_auxiliary_building_ritual_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

	is_foreign = no
	pop_type = burghers
	max_levels = 6
	employment_size = 0.1
	category = infrastructure_category

	town = yes
	city = yes
	megalopolis = yes
	rural_settlement = yes

	important_for_AI = no
	automation_build_allowed = no
	country_potential = { always = no }
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_WONDER_ENGINEERING_ONLY_BUILDING_TT
			always = no
		}
	}
	can_destroy = { always = no }

	build_time = large_cultural_building_time

	modifier = {
		local_cultural_tradition = 0.5
		local_cultural_influence = 0.5
		local_ship_build_speed = 0.8
		max_ships_built_at_same_time = 2
		harbor_suitability = 0.2
	}

	possible_production_methods = {
		tv_wonder_module_maintenance
	}

	on_built = {
		hidden_effect = {
			location = {
				tv_wonder_mechanics_refresh_location_display_state_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}
}
